entries.title: Each task in a chain starts when you approve the one before it
entries.body: In a project whose approved changes merge together in batches, a task waiting on another now starts as soon as you approve that task's merge, on the version you approved, instead of waiting for its batch to merge. This goes down a whole chain: the third task starts when you approve the second, while the first two still wait to merge, and they merge in order. A task that needs the earlier one merged first, such as a release, still waits for the merge.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a waiting task starts, not how any view looks.
